papers.title: High-Resolution Uplink Sensing in Millimeter-Wave ISAC Systems
papers.authors: L. Zhao, Z. Ni, Y. Feng, J. Li, X. Bu, and J. Andrew Zhang

summary.zh: 从毫米波上行通信中，估计目标的角度、距离与速度。
summary.en: Estimating angles, ranges, and velocities from millimeter-wave uplink signals.

question.zh: 一段上行信号，能告诉我们多少环境信息？
question.en: What can an uplink signal tell us about its surroundings?

overview.zh: 混合阵列与收发端时钟不同步，会让毫米波上行感知变得复杂。这项研究结合频域平滑、参考信号构造与 AB2FM 算法，联合估计到达角、多普勒和时延，并保持参数之间的对应关系。
overview.en: Hybrid arrays and unsynchronized clocks complicate uplink sensing. This work combines frequency smoothing, reference-signal construction, and AB2FM to estimate arrival angles, Doppler shifts, and delays while preserving their association.

text.zh: 通过波束扫描和频域平滑，估计静态与动态路径的到达角。
text.en: Beam scanning and frequency smoothing resolve arrival angles for static and moving paths.

text.zh: 构造参考信号，降低收发端时钟不同步对感知的影响。
text.en: A constructed reference signal reduces the impact of unsynchronized transmitter and receiver clocks.

text.zh: 结合到达角与二维 FFT-MUSIC，联合估计多普勒和时延。
text.en: AoA-based 2D-FFT-MUSIC jointly estimates Doppler and delay.

codeNote.zh: MATLAB 仿真包含角度估计、波束形成与时延—多普勒估计。Main.m 设置场景，Params.m 配置阵列和信号参数。
codeNote.en: The MATLAB simulation includes angle estimation, beamforming, and delay–Doppler estimation. Main.m sets up the scenario; Params.m configures the array and signal parameters.

papers.title: Passive Sensing for Multiple Vehicles in Bi-Static ISAC Systems
papers.authors: L. Zhao, Y. Feng, Z. Ni, and X. Bu

summary.zh: 在时钟不同步的双基地系统中，感知多辆车的运动。
summary.en: Sensing multiple vehicles in a bistatic system with unsynchronized clocks.

question.zh: 两个不同步的基站，怎样一起感知车辆？
question.en: How can two unsynchronized base stations sense moving vehicles?

overview.zh: 双基地被动感知可以利用通信信号观察多辆车，但时钟偏差会干扰估计。这项研究通过快拍扩增、SWIP-MUSIC 时偏估计和残余相位对齐，再进行时延—多普勒联合估计。仿真考察了多目标场景下的方法表现。
overview.en: Bistatic passive sensing can observe multiple vehicles using communication signals, but clock offsets interfere with estimation. The method augments snapshots, estimates timing offsets with SWIP-MUSIC, and aligns residual phase before joint delay–Doppler estimation. Simulations examine its behavior with multiple targets.

text.zh: 利用前后向平滑扩增快拍，支持协方差矩阵估计。
text.en: Forward-backward smoothing augments snapshots for covariance estimation.

text.zh: 结合周期图与 MUSIC 估计复合时偏，再处理残余相位偏差。
text.en: Periodogram and MUSIC estimates are combined to recover timing offsets, followed by residual phase alignment.

text.zh: 通过基于周期图的方法，联合估计目标的时延与多普勒。
text.en: A periodogram-based method jointly estimates target delays and Doppler shifts.

codeNote.zh: 从 main.m 运行仿真，在 params.m 中调整参数。仓库还包含会议演示的 LaTeX 源文件与 PDF。
codeNote.en: Run main.m to start the simulation and adjust parameters in params.m. The repository also includes the conference presentation as LaTeX source and PDF.

summary.en: Studying scattering and eavesdropping in terahertz links with wavy surfaces.

papers.title: Design and Implementation of a Highly Efficient Quasi-Cyclic Low-Density Parity-Check Transceiving System Using an Overlapping Decoder

summary.en: Combining QC-LDPC code structure and overlapping decoding in a transceiving system.
